data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Mora was the goddess of the sea. She was also known as the personification of the night and the protector of sailors. Mora's name comes from the Greek word 'mōrē,' which means 'fate' or 'death.'. The name Mora carries the meaning “Goddess of the Sea” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Mora usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of the sea and live with faith, good character and purpose.
